panels.title: Time in Firing State
panels.description: Seconds since each currently-active alert entered its current state (pending or firing), derived from ALERTS_FOR_STATE. Rising lines indicate an incident that has not yet been resolved.

options.content:
## Incident Response Runbooks

When an alert fires, consult the matching runbook in `monitoring/runbooks/` for diagnosis and remediation steps:

- **API_DOWN.md** — API service unreachable / health check failing
- **HIGH_ERROR_RATE.md** — Elevated 5xx error rate on the API
- **HIGH_LATENCY.md** — API request latency above SLO
- **MONGODB_OPLOG_FULL.md** — MongoDB replica set oplog nearing capacity
- **MONGODB_POOL_WAIT_QUEUE.md** — MongoDB connection pool wait queue backing up
- **MONGODB_PRIMARY_DOWN.md** — MongoDB replica set primary unreachable
- **MONGODB_REPLICATION_LAG.md** — MongoDB secondary falling behind primary
- **MONGODB_SECONDARY_FALLING.md** — MongoDB secondary member unhealthy
- **SECRETS_MANAGEMENT.md** — Secrets rotation / access incidents
- **STELLAR_KEYPAIR_DECRYPTION_FAILURE.md** — Stellar keypair decryption failures

Runbooks are versioned alongside this dashboard at `monitoring/runbooks/`.
